description: This file defines the TaxGroup class, representing a tax group entity in the Fineract project. It includes properties, relationships, and methods for creating, updating, and managing tax group data.

classes.name: TaxGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax group with properties, relationships, and methods for managing tax group data within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new TaxGroup instance with specified name and mappings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the TaxGroup's name and mappings based on the provided JsonCommand and set of mappings, returning a map of changes.

methods.name: findOneBy
methods.description: Finds a TaxGroupMappings object within the tax group by matching ID; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Returns the set of TaxGroupMappings associated with this TaxGroup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the TaxGroup.
